title: feat(css): add devtools for CSS variable config
body: **Summary** [FX-3569](https://algolia.atlassian.net/browse/FX-3569) This PR introduces a developer tools panel for InstantSearch CSS that enables real-time configuration and experimentation with CSS variables using [Tweakpane](https://tweakpane.github.io/docs/) library. Changes: - Adds Tweakpane integration for interactive CSS variable configuration - Implements automatic CSS variable config generation from SCSS source files - Provides a `createInstantSearchDevtools()` API for embedding the panel - Provides an inject module for automatic devtools initialization **Result** [FX-3569]: https://algolia.atlassian.net/browse/FX-3569?atlOrigin=eyJpIjoiNWRkNTljNzYxNjVmNDY3MDlhMDU5Y2ZhYzA5YTRkZjUiLCJwIjoiZ2l0aHViLWNvbS1KU1cifQ
